chapter.verse: A kipatcil-in Thu a om hi. Thu in Pasian tawh a omkhawm hi. Thu in Pasian ahi hi.
Amah in a kipatcil-in Pasian tawh a omkhawm hi.
Thu tawh na khempeuh a kipiangsak hi. A kipiangsak khempeuh lakah, Thu loin a kipiangsak khat beek a om kei hi.
Ama sungah nuntakna a om hi. Tua nuntakna in leitung mite ading khuavak ahi hi.
Tua khuavak in khuamial lakah taang a, khuamial in amah a zo zo kei hi.
Johan kici mi khat Pasian in hong sawl hi.
Mi khempeuh in ama hangin thu um dingin teci pang a, khuavakna thu teci pang dingin a hong pai hi.
Amah in khuavak ahi kei hi. Khuavakna thu teci pang dingin hong pai bek ahi hi.
Khuavak taktak a om hi. Tua khuavakna in leitung a, piang mi khempeuh a vaksak hi.
Amah in leitungah a om zo hi. Amah tawh leitung kipiangsak hi. Leitung in amah a thei kei hi.
Amah in ama mite kiangah hong pai-in, ama mite in amah a sang kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah sang a, ama min a umte khempeuh in Pasian’ tate suah theih na’ng thu a pia hi.
Tua tate in si leh sa tawh suak ahi kei uh hi; mihing’ deihna bangin a suak kei uh hi, Pasian’ deihna bangin a suak uh hi.
Thu in mi bangin hong suak a, hehpihna leh thuman thutak tawh kidimin eite lakah a om hi. Pa in a Ta khat bek a piaksa minthan’na bangin ama minthan’na ka mu uh hi.
Johan in ama ading teci pangin a kikona in, “Ka nungah hong paipa in kei om ma-in om ahih ciangin, kei sangin a lianzaw hi, kong cihna in hih pa ahi hi,” ci-in a kiko hi.
Ama kicin’na pan i ngah hehpihna in khat banah khat i ngah sawnsawn hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Thukhamna Moses khut tungah kipia hi; ahih hangin hehpihna leh thuman thutak in Zeisu Khazih khut tungah a hong piang hi.
Pasian kuamah in a mu ngei kei hi. Pa’ ang sungah a om Tapa khat bek in Pasian hong kilangsak hi.
Judah mite in, “Nang kua na hi hiam?” ci-in Johan dong dingin siampite leh Levite Jerusalem khua panin a paisak uh hi.
Johan in tua a teci pan’na im loin, “Kei in Khazih ka hi kei hi,” ci-in tel takin a gen hi.

Tuate in zong, “Tua ahih leh, nang kua na hi hiam? Elijah na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin amah in, “Elijah ka hi kei hi,” a ci hi. “Pasian’ kamsangpa na hi hiam?” a cih uh ciangin, “Ka hi kei hi.” ci-in a dawngkik hi.
Tua ciangin amau in, “Nang kua na hi hiam? Ko hong sawlte kiangah ka genkik theih nadingun, nangmah mah bang kici na hi hiam?” ci-in a dongkik uh hi.
Johan in, “Kamsangpa Isaiah in a gen bangin, ‘Topa paina lam na tangsak in,’ ci-in gampa lakah a kiko aw ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua mite in Farisaite’ paisak ahi uh hi.
Amaute in, “Khazih hi lo, Elijah hi lo, kamsangpa hi lo na hih leh, bang dingin na baptaiz hiam?” ci-in a dongkik uh hi.
Johan in zong, “Keimah in tui sungah ka baptaiz hi. Nomau lakah ding-in a om na theih loh uh ka nungah hong pai mi khat a om hi.
Ama khedap khau phel ding nangawnin ka kilawm kei hi,” a ci kik hi.
Johan baptaizna mun Jordan gun galkhat Bethani khua-ah hih thu khempeuh a piang hi.
Zingsang ciangin Zeisu hong pai Johan in a muh ciangin, “En un, leitung’ mawhna a puakhia Pasian’ Tuuno!
Kei ka om ma-in om ahih ciangin kei sangin a lianzaw ka nungah hong pai hi kong cihpa in hihpa ahi hi.
Kei in tua pa ka thei hi. Ahih hangin amah in Israel mite kiangah a kilat nadingin, keimah in tui sungah baptaiz-in hong pai ka hi hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua lo adang Johan teci pan’na in, “Kha Siangtho vantung pan vakhu bangin hong kumsuka, tua pa tungah a tuang ka mu hi.

Tua pa ka thei kei hi. Ahih hangin tui sungah baptaiz dingin kei hong sawlpa in, ‘Mi khat tungah Kha Siangtho hong kumsuka, a tuang na muh leh, tuapa in Kha Siangtho sungah baptaizpa ahi hi,’ ci-in thu hong pia hi.
Keimah in ka mu zo a, hih pa in Pasian’ Tapa hi ci-in teci ka pang zo hi,” ci-in Johan in a gen hi.
A zing ciangin Johan in a nungzuite nih tawh a din’khop lai takin Zeisu lampi-ah a pai mu a, “Pasian’ Tuuno, en un!” a ci hi.
A nungzui nihte in ama thu a zak uh ciangin, Zeisu’ nung a zui uh hi.

Zeisu kihei a, amaute in a nung a zui uh a muh ciangin, “Bang zong na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amaute in, “Rabbi aw, koi lai-ah om na hi hiam?” ci-in a dawng uh hi. Rabbi a khiatna in ‘Sia’ cihnopna ahi hi.
Zeisu in, “Hong pai le-uh teh na mu ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute pai-in ama omna a mu uh hi. Tua laitak in nitak nai li hi a, ama kiangah a tamkhawm uh hi.
Johan’ thu za a Zeisu’nung a zui nihte khat in Simon Piter’ nau Andru ahi hi.
Amah in a u Simon zong masa a, “Messiah ka mu zo uh hi,” ci-in Zeisu kiangah a paipih hi. Messiah a khiatna in ‘Khazih’ cihnopna ahi hi.
Zeisu in tua pa en a, “Nang in Johan’ tapa Simon na hi hi. Kefas hong kici ding hi,” a ci hi. Kefas in Piter cihnopna hi.
Zing ciangin Zeisu in Galile gamah pai ning ci a, Filip a muh ciangin, “Ka nung hong zui in,” a ci hi.
Filip in Andru leh Piter-te’ teen’na khua Bethsaida khuami ahi hi.
Filip in Nathanael zong a, “Moses in Pasian’ Thukhamna Lai Siangtho sung leh kamsangte in lai sungah a gelhkholhsa Nazareth mi Josef’ tapa Zeisu ka mu zo uh hi,” a ci hi.
Nathanael in, “Nazareth khua sung pan na hoih khat hong piang thei ding hiam?” ci-in a dot leh, Filip in, “Hong pai in la, hong en in,” a ci hi.
Nathanael hong pai Zeisu in a muh ciangin, “En un, ama sungah kheemna om lo Israel mi taktak ahi hi,” ci-in tua pa’ thu a gen hi.
Nathanael in, “Topa aw, bangci hong theih na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin Zeisu in, “Filip in nang hong sap ma-in Theikung nuai-ah na om lai takin ke’n kong mu hi,” ci-in a gen kik hi.
Nathanael in, “Rabbi aw, nangmah in Pasian’ Tapa na hi hi. Israel mite’ kumpipa lah na hi hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Theikung nuai-ah nang kong mu hi ka cih manin hong um na hi hiam? Tua sang a lianzaw nate na mu ding hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, van kihongin Pasian’ vantungmite in Mihing Tapa tungah kahsuk kahto a, om na mu ding hi,” a ci hi.
